title: Cladux registry item
description: One component, block, hook or helper, with its files, in one style.

name.description: Lowercase words joined by dashes, such as date-picker. It's what people type after `cladux add`.

style.description: The style these files are written in: `tailwind` or `css`.

description.description: One sentence, shown by `cladux list` and on the site.

new.description: Marked new on the site and in `cladux list`.

dependencies.description: npm packages the files import, with a version range, such as clsx@^2.1.1.

registryDependencies.description: Other items this one needs. `cladux add` installs them first. A plain name is in the same registry; @acme/button is in the registry named @acme.

path.description: Where the file goes, relative to the folder for its type: aliases.components for ui, aliases.hooks for hook, aliases.lib for lib, css.dir for css.

type.description: registry:ui for components, registry:block for page sections, registry:hook and registry:lib for code they share, registry:style for what `init` installs.
